beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Replacing a Schoology sample now uses a concise Replace or Cancel confirmation that identifies the student, course, learning period, school year, current assignment, and proposed replacement.
• When AI is unavailable, Buddy explains why and offers to start Ollama, open AI settings, or turn AI off. Restoring Ollama can retry the same unchanged grading request once.

Fixes:
• Fixed sample replacement incorrectly reporting that the original was missing when its source files were stored in a backup folder. Undo now preserves original source folders, appended sources, the saved PDF, and verification state.
• Orientation checks on Mac now use the available native OCR engine, including Apple Vision, and leave pages unchanged when results are uncertain.
• Ollama recovery ignores stale warnings after service recovers, stays quiet when AI is inactive, and protects teacher edits, cancellations, and changed source files from delayed retries.
• Improved duplicate-review placement across multiple monitors and made Mac shutdown wait for window cleanup before quitting.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
